name: NDC Ray Transformation
aliases: NDC Ray Conversion for Forward-Facing Scenes
definition: A technique to map a ray in camera space (origin o, direction d) to a ray in NDC space (origin o', direction d') such that the projection of the original ray and the NDC space ray trace out the same points in 3D space, allowing linear sampling in NDC t' to correspond to inverse depth (disparity) sampling in original space.
